lobeHubHarnessWorkflow.rule: LobeHub presents the operator context. Codex inspects real paths, app state, source files, processes, and logs before proposing or editing.
Assign each item to a lane, owner, agent, target path, approval mode, and evidence requirement.
Perform scoped writes only after destination and rollback are clear. Keep restricted paths read-only unless approved.
Run the narrowest useful command, browser check, health check, or artifact validation.
Attach evidence and update AzA records. Project only reviewed summaries to VANTA-Brain.

approvalRequiredFor: posting or messaging from browser or device sessions

purpose: Define the first AzA command-center data model for GTM, product development, content production, team ownership, and Codex execution inside the LobeHub harness.

offer.description: A productized service or software offer being tested or sold.

lead.description: A person, company, creator, agency, or local business in the GTM pipeline.

pilot.description: A paid or unpaid customer validation run with measurable outcomes.

content_campaign.description: A campaign that connects GTM goal, content assets, publishing surfaces, and performance proof.

task.description: A work item owned by a human or software agent.

daily_command_log.description: The daily operator summary for LobeHub as the harness and Codex as the coding executor.

evidence.description: A proof object attached to a claim, task, decision, campaign, or memory record.

roleMap.name: LobeHub
roleMap.responsibility: Owns the command surface, operator views, approvals, boards, and read/write intent flow.

roleMap.name: Codex
roleMap.responsibility: Executes codebase inspection, implementation, shell commands, validation, browser checks, and evidence capture.

roleMap.name: AzA
roleMap.responsibility: Stores typed memory records, provenance, permissions, indexes, verification status, and projection history.

roleMap.name: VANTA-Brain
roleMap.responsibility: Receives reviewed markdown summaries and decision notes after canonical AzA records exist.

sourceOfTruth.rule: LobeHub is the operator harness. Codex is the coding agent that executes implementation, filesystem, terminal, and validation work inside that harness. Write durable records to AzA first, then project reviewed summaries to VANTA-Brain. Do not store raw credentials, private messages, cookies, or tokens.
